label: toolIsNeverSolid: the solid guard dropped, so the Gradient tool's options turn into a solid fill
keepsTwoStops: a refused removal drops the first stop anyway, so a two-stop gradient keeps one
replace: setGradient(GradientRules.removingStop(gradient, index: index) ?? .linear(stops: Array(gradient.stops.dropFirst()), start: Point(x: 0, y: 0), end: Point(x: 1, y: 0)))

label: angleIsIgnored: the angle turns the tool's line, though a drag gives it
replace:
case .angle(let degrees, _):
            setGradient(GradientRules.rotated(gradient, to: degrees, in: Self.unitBox))

label: gradientReachesTheBrush: a gradient edit never reaches the options, so every gesture is lost
